body:
Review pass 44. I executed every README code block to test my own advice, and it was only half right. Correcting it, with a sharper finding underneath.

I said the Rd examples could be lifted from the README since it "already contains a runnable sequence". Ran all 11 blocks:

  1 install (skipped), 7 execute cleanly, 3 FAIL - all on undefined placeholders, not broken code:
    block  9  lm_extractor(...)      object X not found
    block 10  lm_relation_fit(...)   object response_runs not found
    block 11  plan_crossnobis(...)   object fit not found

Illustrative snippets showing API shape - a legitimate style. But they are precisely the three raw-data ENTRY points, so they cannot be lifted into Rd examples. My advice holds for the 7 blocks that start from precomputed effect matrices, and not for these three.

THE SHARPER FINDING, after checking the vignettes too:

  introduction.Rmd     lm_extractor appears in ONE chunk, and it is eval=FALSE (line 347)
                       lm_relation_fit appears only in prose (line 357)
  evidence-pairing.Rmd neither appears
  BOTH vignettes       crossnobis appears ZERO times

So the raw-fMRI entry path - response data through lm_relation_fit or lm_extractor - has no executable documentation anywhere. README block is a placeholder, the vignette chunk is eval=FALSE, neither has an Rd example. Nothing outside the test suite executes it.

And the crossnobis/learned-metric capability - Epics 5, 6, 7, the work this rebuild was organised around - appears in neither vignette. It does have Rd examples, which saves it, but a reader following the narrative never meets it.

That is what makes the criterion bite: "runnable Rd examples cover the first user journey", and the journey starts at response data, not at a precomputed effect matrix. The entry is the least documented part of the package and the only part with no executable coverage in any medium.

ONE FIX SERVES THREE PURPOSES: a small self-contained raw-data fixture - simulate a design and response matrix in a dozen lines - gives you an Rd example for lm_relation_fit and lm_extractor, a replacement for the eval=FALSE vignette chunk, and the missing first-journey example. Write once, reference three times. Details on bd-01KZY2DW2XHE207JMFPVEV957W.
